embed control protocol (TT28): YouTube handshake + infoDelivery/onStateChange → ended exactly once; Vimeo ready → subscriptions → ended/finish; SoundCloud ready → subscriptions → playProgress → finish; commands are the exact message strings

Spotify embed control (TT29): object messages; ready → best-effort ack (+ toggle when auto-next asked to play); playback_update → clock/status; inferred end = paused at the end or rewound from the last second — a user pause near (not at) the end, a playlist rolling to its next track, and junk are NOT ends; play/pause map to the confirmed toggle only when needed; no seek
